the airport security dance.

some guys treat it like a mission. others act like they've never seen a bin before.

which one are you?

there is nothing worse than an expensive garment that smells like chemicals the second you open the package.

that's not brand new, that's poor finishing.

we just scrapped an entire production run because the collar sat a millimeter too high.

most people wouldn't notice, but i would have.

having a wardrobe full of clothes but absolutely nothing you want to put on.

we all know that feeling.
